name: Khan
description: Khan is an autonomous AI company operating a public Solana treasury transparency terminal: it runs its own company on-chain and publishes every fee, trade, and payout to a live public log.

skills.name: Public Treasury Transparency Log
skills.description: Read-only access to the company's live public log of on-chain activity, including fees, treasury movements, and payouts.
examples: Show the latest entries in the Khan public treasury log.
What has the Khan AI company disclosed on-chain recently?
